requirement: Accept a third direction, "nearest": the elevator first moves toward whichever side has the requested floor closest to start, then sweeps as "up" or "down" would from there. If the closest floors above and below are equally far, it goes up; if there are requests on only one side, it goes that way (and with no requests on either side it behaves like "up"). "up" and "down" are unchanged.
desc: An elevator at floor start, moving in direction "up", "down" or "nearest", serves requested floors in SCAN order. Return the floors in the order they are served, each distinct floor once even if requested several times. A request for the start floor is served first. Then, moving up, it serves every requested floor above start in ascending order, then reverses and serves every requested floor below start in descending order; moving down, it serves the floors below start in descending order, then the floors above start in ascending order. "nearest" moves up if there is no requested floor below start, or if there is one above start whose distance from start is at most that of the closest requested floor below start; otherwise it moves down.
